'''2017 MPC Reid Smith LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
